name: HermesEnabler
description: Enable Hermès Watch Faces on any Apple Watch devices
one_liner: A hack that unlocks Hermès-branded Apple Watch faces on any Apple Watch, not just the official $1,500+ Hermès edition.
buyer: No legitimate buyer — this sits in a legal gray area (trademark and anti-circumvention issues) that a real business shouldn't touch.
business_use_cases: An individual Apple Watch owner uses it personally to get Hermès watch faces without buying the branded edition.
A phone/watch repair shop could offer it as a side 'feature unlock' service to walk-in customers, at real legal risk.
A tech YouTuber covers it for views and traffic, though that earns the channel money, not the tool itself.

money_ideas.idea: Charge a small fee to install it for non-technical customers — legally risky and not advisable as a real business

steal_this: Don't build a business on this — it's a trademark and anti-circumvention risk involving Apple and Hermès; honestly skip it.
